builds.name: Reference: Critical carry
builds.goal: Reference for Akshan: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A mobile ranged skirmisher who combines repeat attacks and ability hits for three-hit damage, then seeks takedown swing resets. Cancelling the second shot offers a deliberate mobility tradeoff. Compare completing the second shot with cancelling it for movement; log three-hit passive procs and swing attacks landed, not just attack speed. Attack cadence, crit and penetration support repeatable carry damage.
testPlan: Kit question for Akshan: Compare completing the second shot with cancelling it for movement; log three-hit passive procs and swing attacks landed, not just attack speed.

Start with the early core (Kraken, then Infinity Edge) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Attack cadence, crit and penetration support repeatable carry damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Akshan throws a boomerang that deals damage going out and coming back, extending its range each time it hits an enemy. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Crit is valuable only for effects that can crit; low defense makes positioning decisive.
The route fails Akshan's stated kit question: Compare completing the second shot with cancelling it for movement; log three-hit passive procs and swing attacks landed, not just attack speed.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Crit is valuable only for effects that can crit; low defense makes positioning decisive.
Full cost 16,950 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Kraken, then Infinity Edge. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Phantom Dancer, Lord Dominik's Regards, Bloodthirster are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
After launching an Attack, Akshan will fire an additional shot for [(0.5) × AD] physical damage. He can cancel this shot to instead gain [(characterLevelInterpolation(20 → 75; raw flags preserved)) × ((1 + (1) × Stat(4)[statFormula=2]))] Move Speed decaying over [1] second.

Every three hits from Attacks or Abilities deals an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=15, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 25.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 40.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 70.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.6) × AP] magic damage. Against champions, Akshan also gains [characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 280; raw flags preserved) + (0.35) × AD[statFormula=2]] Shield for [2] seconds ([characterLevelBreakpoints(start=16, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] second Cooldown).

Akshan throws a boomerang that deals [45 / 75 / 105 / 135 / 165 + (0.7) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, extending the range each time an enemy is hit.

Champion hits grant Akshan [0.2 + (0.0005) × AP] Move Speed decaying over [1] second.
{{ Spell_AkshanW_Tooltip_[1] }}

First Cast: Akshan fires a grappling hook, attaching to the first terrain hit.

Second Cast: Akshan swings around the terrain, repeatedly firing at the nearest enemy for [(8 / 16 / 24 / 32 / 40 + (0.25) × AD) × ((1 + (0.3) × Stat(4)[statFormula=2]))] physical damage per shot.

Third Cast: Akshan dives off the rope, firing a final shot.

Colliding with an enemy Champion or terrain ends the swing early.

Champion takedowns refresh this Ability's Cooldown.

Akshan locks onto a champion and begins overcharging his gun for up to [2.5] seconds, storing up to [5 / 6 / 7] bullets.

Recast: Akshan unleashes the stored bullets, each dealing at least [(25 / 35 / 45 + (0.15) × AD) × ((1 + ((0.3) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] physical damage to the first enemy or structure hit, increased up to [((25 / 35 / 45 + (0.15) × AD) × ((1 + ((0.3) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))) × (3)] physical damage based on missing Health.
